svg.title: Where the acceleration comes from
svg.desc: Two pairs of attention tracks. With manual coordination, agent work stops after each step and I fill the gaps by rebuilding context, checking status and passing work along. With the harness, agents work in longer, parallel stretches, events bring the results back, and my time gathers at the brief and the decision. Conceptual lanes, not durations.
svg.text: the work waits on me between every step
conceptual lanes · not durations or a benchmark
